pricing.note: No fresh, permitted sportsbook odds are available, so every card is a model suggestion: no price, no payout, not a bet. Settles on the official final.

methodologyDependencies.effect: NBA legs are game winners only. Player props are not legs: the official lane publishes medians only, and no over/under probability or threshold is derived from a median.
methodologyDependencies.proposedMethod: Publish a per-player, per-stat P(stat >= threshold) from the frozen v0.1 simulation draws (the same 10,000 runs the medians come from), for thresholds set by a rule fixed in advance, only after the band-80 coverage of those draws passes a preregistered check on graded 2026-27 games. Needs founder approval before any build reads it.

methodologyDependencies.effect: No card is qualified (bettable): no fresh, permitted sportsbook odds exist, and provider terms bar public price JSON.
methodologyDependencies.proposedMethod: An authorized NBA price feed with terms that permit display, then the established Level B gates.

nfl.reason: No reader for the NFL official game forecast has been reviewed for Level A yet; NFL stays out until one is.

ufc.reason: UFC has no independent official forecast: its moneyline is a de-vigged market price with a capped nudge.

band.method: Joint probability = product of each leg's official forecast probability, legs from different games only (treated as independent across games). Tier = the published risk band of the model-fair price (1 ÷ joint). No sportsbook price is used.

card.rationale: Each leg is the official NBA side with its MODEL PROJECTION win chance from the frozen Elo team rating; this is the combination with the highest joint chance in the Low Risk band (2 legs).
card.confidence: MODEL PROJECTION accuracy is not yet established over a large forward sample.
card.dependency: Assumes the games are independent: every leg is a different NBA game, so no two legs share a team, but same-night results can still be related (travel, schedule, league-wide scoring) and that is not modelled.
card.disclosure: Model Performance: the Elo rating’s game-outcome accuracy is not yet established — 107 regular-season games graded so far; the preregistration requires 300 before any accuracy claim. An estimate derived from the Elo team rating — not an independently validated probability, not a simulation result, and not a betting recommendation.
